mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_browse_history (user_id, content_id, browse_date, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentId}, #{browseDate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE create_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT content_id FROM tb_browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
